title: Gherkin: Mutex API acquire, renew, release, inspect; failed conditional check
description:
## Behavior to specify

Hard mutex primitive: atomically create/claim resource X iff nobody currently owns X.

API shape (tiny): acquire, renew, release, inspect.

Failed conditional write → claim rejected.

DynamoDB stores only live lease records; delete on complete; TTL for garbage collection.

No Lambda. No AppSync. Direct API Gateway → DynamoDB.

## Acceptance

Gherkin is the contract for the client and for the arbitration semantics. Infrastructure prototype is a separate task.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Gherkin draft: features/coordination/mutex_api.feature (@wip). Acquire/renew/release/inspect, conditional failure, live-lease-only storage semantics (no AWS in specs).

right_now_summary: A Gherkin draft now defines mutex acquire, renew, release, inspect, and failed claims.
